apertura.slogan: Find races worth the effort, and the people who've really run them.
misura.intro: Climbing counts: every 100 m of D+ equals 1 km.
formula.esempio: Example: 50 km with 3,000 m of D+ = 80 km-effort.
formula.fonte: This is ITRA's km-effort, the measure of effort used in trail running.
badge.intro: Each distance is compared with the reference race in its country, for the same effort.
badge.verde.testo: Costs less than the reference race, for the same effort.
badge.giallo.testo: Past the fair-price threshold: getting close to big-circuit prices.
badge.rosso.testo: Prices of a major international circuit.
schede.titolo: Race pages built for trail running
schede.intro: Everything you need to choose and prepare, in one place.
schede.percorso.testo: Distance, elevation gain, GPX track with map and elevation profile.
schede.regolamento.testo: Cut-off times, aid stations and mandatory kit, with a link to the official source.
schede.cosa.testo: What the entry fee includes, and what you pay for separately.
schede.storico.testo: How much it has gone up since the previous edition, at the same price tier.
fiducia.fonti.testo: No estimated values. If something isn't verified, we say so.
fiducia.finisher.testo: Runners prove they finished with Strava or the official results.
fiducia.community.testo: Lift sharing, course recces, finding a pacer.
fiducia.conflitti.testo: Organisers can't review their own race, and sponsored content is always labelled.
